title: Unreal Engine 3 in Firefox with asm.js
summary: Mozilla's short demo of Unreal Engine 3 running in Firefox, ported by Mozilla and Epic in four days using Emscripten and asm.js.
why: HN cites it as proof of how capable browsers became, a landmark for asm.js and WebAssembly.

quote.text: See the video at (second half of video) for the Sanctuary UT3 map, complete with bots, shooting, etc.
